summary: Tested the Overview period filter (Today/Week/Month/Year/All/Pick date) on backend and frontend, plus the fix that reads Follow Up Date by position. Every feature in the request works. Backend: 13/13 new tests pass, and their counts were checked against MongoDB directly. Full regression: 54/55 passed; 1 flaky. UI: on every period, the KPI, day-arrived, assigned+unassigned, treatment total, stage total and leaderboard total all match (today 67, week 16-22 Nov 209, month Nov 896, year 2026 2129, all 2342, 17 Nov 81). Today is the default and the date input only shows after clicking Pick date. Clicking a leaderboard row on a single day goes to /leads?bdm=Usman&date=2026-11-17. Muskaan (BDM) sees only her own leads, no leaderboard and 0 unassigned. At 390px there is no horizontal overflow and the buttons wrap. The sheet header after Status is ' ' (blank); follow-up dates are read: overdue 656, due today 115-116.

minor.issue: A ?date=YYYY-MM-DD with no period is now ignored and silently returns today (it used to return that day). This breaks old callers and old tests; I updated the tests to send period=date or period=all.
overdue, due_today and all_time_leads do not follow the selected period. They look like 'as of today' or global numbers by design, but the KPI cards don't say so.

issues: Pick date uses the browser's built-in date input instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover picker.
The selected period lives only in component state, so going back from /leads resets it to Today. Consider keeping it in the URL (?period=&date=).
The BDM subtitle 'Here's your personal pipeline today.' doesn't change when another period is picked.
The first load sends GET /overview?period=today twice (probably React StrictMode or a double effect). Harmless.

action_items: Optional: treat /api/overview?date=X with no period as period=date, for backward compatibility.
Optional: label the Due today / Overdue / All-time cards as not following the selected period.
Optional: replace the built-in date input with the shadcn Calendar, and keep the period in the URL.
critical_code_review_comments: period_range and the overview logic are correct: week is Mon-Sun, month is the calendar month, year is the calendar year, bad dates return 400 through valid_date.

The sheet_rows fallback only works if the blank header is directly after 'status'. If the sheet columns move again it will quietly stop reading dates; consider a warning log when no follow-up column is found.
The overview endpoint makes about 8 sequential DB calls. Fine at the current size of 2.3k leads.
flaky_tests: test_surgiassist_crm.py::TestLeadMutations::test_edit_note_reminder_sync_allocation: failed once in the parallel xdist run, passed when run alone (likely a race with a concurrent sync).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. The iteration-4 test reads MongoDB directly to compute expected counts for each office_date range. Server date is 2026-11-18 IST. Old tests now use period=all or period=date for /api/overview.
